name: Hu tieu
summary: A breakfast noodle soup seasoned saltier and less sweet than the southern bowl. It is common here, though not a local specialty.
origin: VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 says hủ tiếu is common at breakfast in Buon Ma Thuot and is not a local specialty.
howToEat: Choose meat-and-bone, wonton, or Nam Vang, from a pavement cart or a larger room.
where: Pavement carts and larger rooms around town.
seoTitle: Hu tieu in Buon Ma Thuot — breakfast, not a specialty
seoDescription: Breakfast hu tieu in Buon Ma Thuot, saltier and less sweet than the southern bowl: meat-and-bone, wonton, or Nam Vang.
